assessment.reason: The model-favored under holds across the supplied sensitivity range at -150, and no listed fact clearly undercuts it. The gap to the market is moderate rather than extreme. This is not a validated edge.

assessment.context_case: Florida's listed absences cut both ways: a thinner attack supports the under, but promotion would hurt it. They predate recent games, so they may already be reflected. The Winnipeg goalie remains projected on a back-to-back.

qualitative_review.countercase: With Barkov and Marchand out, Luostarinen could be pushed into top-six or power-play minutes beyond the 16-minute projection, raising his point chance. A tired Winnipeg goalie on a back-to-back could also lift Florida scoring.
